verdict.rationale: Rainforest has a documented API reference section, including endpoint pages such as Create merchant. It also publishes an OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification and offers end-to-end sandbox testing with test cards. That gives a basis for exploring and trying the API. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable "try it" examples, and probes of common OpenAPI paths returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an interactive try-it console in the reference, runnable code samples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
